name: tpl-chain-response-1-goal
task: Carry the box to the exit. Whenever the box falls, pick it up again on your very next move.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: The hard Existence(at_exit) captures reaching the exit but omits the task’s requirement to carry the box there. Add hard Response(at_exit, holding_box), so the box must still be held on the exit step. Keep the hard ChainResponse(box_fell, holding_box), which correctly requires picking it up on the next step after each fall.

NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(at_exit) and Response(at_exit, holding_box) require reaching the exit while carrying the box. ChainResponse(box_fell, holding_box) requires picking it up on the very next step after every fall.

texts: Reach the exit while carrying the box.
Carry the box when reaching the exit.
Whenever the box falls, pick it up on the very next step.
